title: Shared context and incentives make local authority usable
text: The structured note describes distributed intelligence as depending on shared cross-functional context and a culture reinforced through rewards, roles and actual decisions. Granting nominal autonomy without those supports may simply relocate coordination work to overloaded local teams.
qualification: Book-derived management argument. Centralised context can also concentrate control and failure, a tension identified in the supplied analysis.
